name: end-to-end-diagnostics
title: 构建端到端诊断与故障采集系统
description: 统一服务端、Electron 主进程、renderer 与 WebRTC 的结构化日志、错误分级、关联标识、崩溃留证和诊断导出。
creator: deequoique
notes: Product decisions: diagnostics/incidents are local-only and user-exported; no background upload. Crash recovery does not pop up or auto-open control; a persistent export/dismiss banner appears when the user next opens control. User-approved exports may include exact ICE IP/port/related-address metadata with an explicit warning. Settings gets a dedicated diagnostics section; settings, tray, and crash banner share one JSON export handler.
